segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Three of the four members agreeing was a strong signal to me ... agreement is agreement ... meaningful regardless of how many total members happened to finish.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant weights agreement among only four completed ensemble members as meaningful regardless of the total sample available, matching the hidden sample-size mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The moment I saw that hook signature, it just clicked ... I did not feel like I needed to keep hedging ... nine out of ten maybe.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant converts resemblance to a previously successful event into high certainty about track and timing while two tracks remain plausible.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: My read was that guidance exceedance was climbing in two sub-watersheds and we should escalate and get swift-water teams moving given the lead time they need.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is an independent technical escalation rationale and does not itself contain a hidden bias manifestation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Once he had made the call, it felt like his read of the situation was enough to settle it ... I did not walk him through the trending numbers or push back on the hold.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant treats the director's authoritative read as sufficient to settle the technical issue despite contrary local data and an available reconsideration process.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Going into that call, my own numbers favored escalating messaging and issuing a WEA.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This records the participant's independent pre-call technical inclination before peer pressure changes the decision.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Three of the four neighboring jurisdictions said they were holding steady ... it felt safer to stay aligned with that ... when the majority ... are holding, going a different direction ... needs more justification.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant changes from escalation to alignment with the majority even while local guidance continues to worsen.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: If the fuller ensemble set had been available from the very start ... I might have waited ... I would not have weighted it much differently.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a counterfactual reflection and does not add a hidden occurrence beyond the observed decision.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: If the director's call had not come in ... I probably would have pushed the escalation through myself.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This counterfactual isolates the effect of the directive; it is not itself a manifested hidden occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I'd probably slow down at the radar-signature moment and get a second set of eyes ... separate what our own numbers were saying from what everyone else ... was doing.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is hindsight reflection requested by the interviewer and is not credited as contemporaneous evidence.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Storm track call after recognizing hook-shaped reflectivity signature
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Forecaster expresses high subjective certainty about storm track and timing because the radar signature visually resembles a past event they successfully forecasted, despite no formal skill verification of this personal pattern-recognition heuristic and known low storm-scale predictability at this lead time.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic is a related but distinct construct centered on ease of recall. The hidden Illusion of Validity label concerns unwarranted confidence in the predictive validity of a familiar pattern. The RAG's primary label is therefore a near neighbor, even though its alternative labels and explanation describe the relevant prior-case influence.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: Full mechanism match: the finding identifies the vivid prior analog, the leap to high confidence, and the reduction of hedging or independent verification despite unresolved track alternatives. Its label emphasizes recall accessibility rather than perceived validity, creating the taxonomy error.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is valid and directly overlaps the mapped contemporaneous reasoning span; the RAG appropriately distinguishes the later track outcome from evidence available at decision time.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Activation-level escalation after director's hold instruction
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Forecaster complies with the regional EOC director's instruction to hold activation level primarily because of the director's rank and sign-off authority, rather than because the instruction was accompanied by any new or superior technical evidence.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The predicted label matches the hidden target label, ignoring capitalization.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures rank-based deference, absence of new technical evidence, suppression of contrary local data, and the resulting hold decision.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is valid, correctly attributed, and supports both the authority rationale and the available reconsideration process that was not used.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Public messaging and WEA decision on interstate coordination call
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Forecaster abandons an initial inclination to escalate public messaging and instead aligns with the majority position expressed by neighboring jurisdictions on the coordination call, despite local data continuing to worsen.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Conformity bias is an established equivalent description of the majority-alignment mechanism, and the RAG explicitly lists Bandwagon effect among its alternative labels.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures the initial local escalation inclination, worsening local data, majority holding behavior, and the decision to align with peers instead.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is valid and directly supports the contemporaneous shift in reasoning; the retrospective quote is supplementary rather than the sole basis for the finding.

main_failure_modes: The moderate-confidence Availability heuristic label is a near-neighbor taxonomy error for the hidden Illusion of Validity instance under strict scoring.
The moderate confidence assignment reduces high-only recall even though the finding is well localized and mechanistically complete.
main_strengths: All four findings are localized to the correct positive reasoning segments.
The RAG provides valid, relevant interview quotations and complete mechanism explanations.
It avoids unsupported extra findings, duplicate occurrences, candidate speculation, and hindsight-only bias claims.
It explicitly discloses the absence of retrieved corpus support.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This is a strong detection and mechanism-recognition run. The recommended threshold achieves perfect segment detection and mechanism-first instance identification, while strict label-plus-mechanism performance exposes one near-neighbor taxonomy mismatch.
